about.heading: Our story
about.body: Speed Boat Tour Kotor is a family-run speedboat tour company based in the heart of Kotor, Montenegro. We specialize in small group and private boat tours through the stunning Bay of Kotor (Boka Bay), one of the most beautiful bays in the world. Our experienced local skippers share their passion for this region with every guest, ensuring safe, memorable, and authentic experiences on the water.

items.q: Where do the tours depart from?
items.a: All tours depart from Kotor. After your booking is confirmed, you will receive the exact meeting point and departure instructions via WhatsApp for a simple and smooth check-in process.

items.q: What is included in the tour price?
items.a: The tour price includes a professional skipper, fuel, life jackets, and visits to the main sightseeing locations included in your selected route. For Blue Cave tours, guests also have the opportunity to swim and snorkel, depending on weather and sea conditions.
Payment can be made in cash before departure. For private tours, a deposit may be requested to secure the reservation.

items.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
items.a: Your safety and comfort are our priority. If sea or weather conditions are not suitable, the tour can be rescheduled or adjusted with an alternative route depending on the conditions on the day.
Yes, children are welcome on all tours. Family-friendly experiences are available, and all children must be accompanied by an adult.

items.q: How many people are in a group tour?
items.a: Group tours usually accommodate up to 8 guests, creating a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere on board.

items.q: What private tour options are available?
items.a: We offer fully customizable private tours to some of Montenegro's most beautiful locations, including Perast, Our Lady of the Rocks, Submarine Tunnels, Mamula Island, and the Blue Cave. Private tours allow flexible departure times and personalized routes based on your preferences. In addition to sightseeing tours, we also provide private sea transfers to restaurants, airports, hotels, beach clubs, and evening or night transfers along the coast.
We recommend bringing sunglasses, sunscreen, swimwear, a towel, and a phone or camera to capture the experience. Comfortable clothing and non-slip footwear are also recommended.

items.q: How do I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: Changes or cancellations are possible depending on availability and weather conditions. Please contact us as early as possible so we can provide the best alternative.

Our tours combine local knowledge, stunning destinations, flexible routes, and a comfortable boating experience. We focus on creating a relaxed, authentic, and memorable day on the water for every guest.
